result.title: A Geometrical Approach to Constructing Neural Networks for Perfect Training-set Classification
result.summary: This paper proposes a method for constructing a neural network that achieves perfect classification of all samples in a given training set, without taking regularization into account. The network is constructed on-demand, with its layer sizes and neuron parameters determined through a geometrical analysis of the input data, in which separating hyperplanes are created and mapped to neurons with step activation functions. The proposed architecture consists of two hidden layers with distinct roles: inter-class separation and transformation of the data into a linearly separable representation. Inter-class separation requires every bi-chromatic pair of samples belonging to different classes to be separated by at least one hyperplane. We show that when this separation is achieved through a hierarchical partitioning of the data, the leaf nodes of the oblique decision tree, obtained as a byproduct, directly define the neurons of the linear separability layer, whose size is only one neuron greater than that of the inter-class separation layer. Experiments on the MNIST dataset demonstrate that the proposed method achieves perfect training-set classification, and compact models. The direct correspondence between the decision tree and network neurons enhances interpretability and explainability, while the construction procedure offers opportunities for parallel implementation and improved scalability.

AI.brief_summary: 该文提出一种几何构造法：通过分析输入数据生成分离超平面，构建含两层隐藏层（类间分离层与线性可分变换层）的神经网络，并以斜决策树的叶节点直接对应神经元，在 MNIST 上实现训练集完美分类且模型紧凑。
AI.relevance_reason: 其超平面分离与斜决策树叶节点—神经元对应，可能为分析 VLM 内部分层几何结构与表示可分性提供可核查的视角，但与 latent 推理状态的生成、使用及视觉证据筛选无直接联系，属较远领域的概念线索。
